notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Now you can choose between the original and the new timer bomb experience, In the new experience, you have a limited time to catch the birds before the bomb explodes and make you fall all the way to the ground.
This makes the game more exciting and fun.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Now you can press the s key on your keyboard to skip to the next level, for example, if a player gets stuck on a level.

Also, the birds are now closer to catch in the new levels.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
10 new levels to experience.
The experience is now divided into 3 sections, Basic, Medium, and Extreme.
Now you can restart from the beginning by pressing the r key on your keyboard.
